pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Check that the tag matches package.json
steps.run:
version="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')"
if [ "$REF_NAME" != "v$version" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag $REF_NAME does not match package.json version $version."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Create the draft release
steps.run:
if gh release view "$REF_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release $REF_NAME already exists."
  exit 0
fi
awk -v heading="### $REF_NAME " '
  index($0, heading) == 1 {found = 1; next}
  found && /^### / {exit}
  found {print}
' changelog.md >notes.md
if [ ! -s notes.md ]; then
  echo "::error::changelog.md has no entry for $REF_NAME."
  exit 1
fi
gh release create "$REF_NAME" --draft --title="$REF_NAME" --notes-file=notes.md
